title: Carpenter Shorts - Light Wash
sourceText: Our iconic Carpenter Jeans turned into shorts. We took this classic workwear style and made it our own with contrast stitching and broken twill denim. Pockets galore, hammer loop, and our signature key loop on the waist band. Long inseam. These jean shorts are made from a heavy-duty 14.5oz 100% cotton denim that was custom woven for us in one of America’s oldest denim mills. Woven in our signature broken twill pattern to call upon fabrics from the past. Softened using eco-friendly abrasives meant to mimic stonewashing— This process saves water, electricity, time, and creates almost zero waste compared to traditional stonewashing. These jeans are a timeless staple and will only get better and better with each wear. Please Note — There will be slight variations on washes. These shorts have roughly a 7” inseam. Cut, sewn & eco-stonewashed in Los Angeles. Made with 100% cotton denim that custom woven for us in one of america’s oldest denim mills.

sourceText: Amethyst Botanical Fur Trim Coat is the ultimate fall statement piece for a dark, romantic wardrobe. This mid-length black coat pairs a soft, suede-like finish with plush amethyst-purple faux fur trim along the oversized collar, front opening, cuffs, and hem for dramatic warmth and texture. Intricate embroidery—featuring bats, snakes, and moody botanical florals—runs down the front and sleeves, giving you a gothic-boho look that stands out at concerts, nights out, and chilly seasonal strolls. Color: Black coat with amethyst faux fur trim Details: Embroidered bats, snakes, and botanical fall motifs on front and sleeves Closure: Hook closures at center front (chest and waist) Pockets: Side pockets Length: Approx. 32" (size XS) and 35" (size XL) Style: Mid-length gothic/alternative statement outerwear Styling tip: Layer it over lace tops, dresses, or denim for an effortless boho goth outfit—let the amethyst fur collar frame your look. FAQ: Is the fur real? No—this coat features faux fur trim. Does it have functional pockets? Yes, it includes side pockets. Where is the embroidery placed? On the front panels and down the sleeves.

title: Fern Burnout Crop T-Shirt
sourceText: Meet your new go-to black crop boxy tee with a twist: the Fern Burnout Crop T-Shirt pairs a comfy, everyday fit with a striking semi-sheer fern burnout across the upper chest, shoulders, and sleeves. The contrast of solid black body fabric with the delicate leaf pattern creates an elevated look that’s equal parts witchy and wearable—easy to dress up with layered chains and boots or keep casual with denim. Style: Short sleeve, relaxed fit, slightly cropped Neckline: Classic crew neck Design detail: Sheer fern burnout paneling on yoke/shoulders/sleeves Color: Black Occasion: Everyday, concert, festival, night out, alt/goth-inspired looks Fit & sizing notes: Model is 5'3" wearing a SM (approximately 19" long). title: Nocturnal Garden Skater Skirt
sourceText: Step into a moonlit mood with the Nocturnal Garden Skater Skirt —a flattering, high-waisted skater silhouette made from premium cotton spandex jersey that feels smooth, supportive, and ready for day-to-night styling. The dark, celestial-and-botanical print features mystical motifs like crescent moons, stars, moths, owls, and serpents, finished with a romantic Chantilly lace hem for an elevated boho-goth edge. sourceText: A wear-everywhere essential. Simple and polished, the long sleeve crew is your go-to over and under layer. Made from our newly sustainable fine ribbed jersey that's supremely soft and fits like it was made just for you.

title: Odeon Stretch Cotton Chambray Shirtdress - Cove Blue
sourceText: Everyone’s favorite luxe shirtdress now comes in stretch cotton chambray. Lightweight and breathable, the silhouette is streamlined and simple with only the most considered details—a point collar, a full button placket, functional sleeve cuffs, and slits at the curved hem. And, while oversized, the silhouette is clean and polished. But we’ve added some nice distressing details along the edges. We love this as a dress, of course, but also as an open duster jacket! 98% Cotton 2% Elastane Machine Wash Cold, only non-chlorine bleach when needed. tumble dry low. Cool iron if needed.

title: All Day Palais Wide Leg Pants - Goji Berry
sourceText: Elevate your suiting game with the All Day Wide Leg Pants, the perfect blend of sharp tailoring and everyday comfort. These pants feature stitched down front knife pleats for a sleek silhouette, back darts to enhance the fit, and front slash pockets for practicality. An encased elastic waistband at the back ensures a gap-free fit, while belt loops offer styling versatility. Made from our comfortable, sustainable All Day suiting fabric, this lightweight wide-leg style delivers a powerful yet polished look, pairing effortlessly with any blazer in the collection. 66% Polyester 30% Rayon 4% Spandex Machine wash cold, inside out, like color, hang dry

title: Kidjo Tailored Wool Blend Jacket - Pageant Blue
sourceText: Meet your perfect city coat. Tailored and chic, it’s made from our luxe wool blend. Key details include the single button closure, patch pockets at the hips, and a subtle peplum-style hem. We love wearing this style with a dressier outfit but it also looks cute with jeans.

title: Risa Sweater Skirt - Supernova
sourceText: Our Better-Than-Wool sweaters are essential and stylish pieces for fall—so what better way to embrace perfection than by wearing them head to toe? In this winter-warm yarn that’s always smooth and never prickly on the skin, we developed our pull-on Risa Sweater Skirt. With a gentle A-line silhouette, a soft hug at the hips, and encased elastic at the waist, comfort, ease, and style are knitted into every stitch.

title: Marlo Cocoon Coat - Gamay
sourceText: Vintage-inspired and timeless, the Marlo Coat is a true hero piece. Made from a soft and warm wool or custom herringbone tweed, it’s tailored to have a structured cocoon silhouette that feels cozy and not restrictive. It’s a sophisticated take on the everyday wool coat… because everyone needs a small dose of couture in their wardrobe. Details include the funnel neck, dropped shoulders, off-center buttons, and hip pockets. Coat is fully lined.

title: Noomi Cold Shoulder Sweater - Dark Gray
sourceText: Inspired by Scandinavian design, the Noomi Sweater is an understated ‘cold shoulder’ silhouette that is both cozy and versatile. Made in our Better-Than-Wool yarn, it’s blended to be warm for the cooler months, but soft on the skin and easy to care for. The neckline is designed to be worn either on the shoulders—creating an elegant, wide-cut boat neck—or, thanks to its slightly oversized fit, pulled off to one side for a cold shoulder effect. Wear it bare, or pair it with a tee or cami underneath for that nonchalant layered look.

title: Savvy Fine Knit Everyday Sweater Dress - Classic Camel
sourceText: Sophisticated and easy: the refined silhouette and soft feel of our everyday sweater dress make sweater dressing both a necessity and a pleasure for fall. Cut with an easy fit at the bust and waist, and with ample room in the sleeves, our sweater dress skims the hip and is finished with fine rib trims that feel smooth against the skin. A lightweight sweater dress that can be worn solo or layered with your favorite winter coat.

title: Gabrielle Button-Front Cardigan - Almond Dust/Cream Trim
sourceText: Elegance is the Gabrielle Cardigan. Simple, sleek, and versatile, our crew-neck cardigan nods to classic vintage style, but in a thoroughly modern way. Cut a little shorter in the body so that it kisses the high hip, the modern proportions of this style allow it to fit seamlessly into your everyday outfitting needs. Made using our signature Better-than-Wool yarn, this jacquard knit offers a bit more structure without sacrificing any softness against the skin. The placket is engineered to prevent spreading, making it wearable as both a cardigan and a top. Finally, the button details, pockets, and finishes add that extra touch of class.

title: Maine Stretch Flannel Shirtdress - Garnet Plaid
sourceText: This is the fall staple. Comfy, fuzzy stretch flannel will keep you cozy through the chilliest days. It’s the dress version of your favorite Maine Stretch Flannel Shirt. We tailored the body just a touch for a more elevated silhouette. Details include the button placket, chest pockets, hip pockets, button cuffs, and a curved hem.

title: Maine Stretch Flannel Shirt - Kent Plaid
sourceText: Your quintessential oversize shirt for every day. It looks like fall and feels so luxurious you’ll wear it all year long. Made from an incredibly soft and stretchy flannel, it’s bouncy and light. Details include the button placket, chest pockets, button cuffs, and curved hem.

title: Soft Spun Polo Sweater - Winter Fawn
sourceText: The lofty, lush feel of our Soft Spun yarn is perfect for the Polo Sweater. This smooth-to-the-touch knit is cut with ease through the body, with fuller sleeves that softly balloon at the cuffs and a ribbed hem that finishes at the hip, creating a soft blouson effect at the waist. Smart enough to wear as a top and cozy enough to layer, too.

title: The Refined Lou High Rise Barrel Leg Jeans - Anzio Blue
sourceText: These are the jeans you need right now. High-waisted with a roomy barrel leg. It took five rounds of fittings to perfect this of-the-moment silhouette. With just enough volume that tapers at the ankle, they're made from a structured (but still stretchy) denim that holds its shape. We designed these to be styled two ways—play with sizing to find your favorite fit. Choose your true size if you’re into the oversize look, and size down if you want these jeans to feel fitted through the hips.

title: UltimateS Lorelai Lounge Shorts - Fine Stripe in Navy/White
sourceText: We made everyone's favorite lounge shorts in our light-as-air UltimateS fabric. You'll love slipping into these after a long day. They feature an extra-stretchy encased elastic waistband (that won't twist), front scoop pockets that are as functional as they are comfy, and an inseam that hits just above the knee.
